ActorTalk: Commandant... why are you inside my M.I.N.D.?
I see... I didn't realize things had gotten that bad. Maybe I was careless—no, anything can happen in battle.
New Sophiasburgh was attacked by Corrupted... The glacier suddenly split open and they just kept pouring out.
I gathered my squad and we formed a defensive line. We held them back out on the ice.
Then in the middle of the fight, a jet-black Construct broke out from among the Corrupted and started attacking us.
I stayed behind to cover the retreat. And well... this is what happened.
Yes, and I checked—they weren't an Ascendant. Oh, right, Commandant, you mentioned Miss Mina is here too?
She's a bit strange, and honestly kinda hates Babylonia. I didn't expect her to come along.
A Construct working with the Corrupted?
We've got a fake "Mina" amongst us.
